# arcane Provider



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure the Arcane provider with no authentication
provider "arcane" {
  address = "https://arcane.example.com"
}

# Configure the Arcane provider with token authentication
provider "arcane" {
  alias = "authenticated"

  address = "https://arcane.example.com"
  token   = "<YOUR_API_TOKEN_HERE>"

  insecure = true # Set to true if using self-signed certificates
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address` (String)
- `insecure` (Boolean)
- `token` (String)
